contentObjective: I can convert measurement units using ratios and conversion factors.
languageObjective: I can explain my conversion using the words conversion factor, unit, equivalent, and ratio.

vocabulary.definition: Rename a measurement in a different unit without changing its amount.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Expresar una medida en una unidad diferente sin cambiar su cantidad.
vocabulary.cloze: Renaming a measurement in a different unit without changing the amount is to ___ it.

examples.why: The amount changed, not just the unit.

vocabulary.definition: A ratio that helps you change one unit into another.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una razón que te ayuda a cambiar una unidad por otra.
vocabulary.visual: 1 foot = 12 inches, so the factor is 12
vocabulary.cloze: A ratio equal to 1 that relates two units, like 12 inches / 1 foot, is a ___.

examples.why: The ratio that trades one unit for another.
That is the amount being converted.

vocabulary.definition: A standard amount used to measure, like an inch or a liter.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una cantidad estándar para medir, como una pulgada o un litro.
vocabulary.cloze: A standard amount used to measure, like a foot or a gram, is a ___.

examples.why: A standard amount you measure with.
That counts units; it is not one.

vocabulary.definition: Having the same value, just in different units.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Tener el mismo valor, solo en unidades distintas.
vocabulary.cloze: Two measurements that name the same amount, like 1 foot and 12 inches, are ___.

examples.why: The same amount, named two ways.

vocabulary.definition: A way to compare two amounts, like 3 to 2.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una manera de comparar dos cantidades, como 3 a 2.
vocabulary.cloze: A comparison of two quantities is a ___.

vocabulary.definition: The U.S. way of measuring, like inches, feet, and pounds.
vocabulary.definitionEs: La forma de medir de EE. UU., como pulgadas, pies y libras.
vocabulary.visual: 12 inches = 1 foot, 3 feet = 1 yard, 16 ounces = 1 pound
vocabulary.cloze: Units like inches, feet, and pounds used mainly in the U.S. are ___.

examples.why: A foot is a customary unit of length.
A meter is a metric unit.

vocabulary.definition: A way of measuring by 10s, like meters, liters, and grams.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una forma de medir de 10 en 10, como metros, litros y gramos.
vocabulary.cloze: Units like meters, grams, and liters based on tens are ___.

examples.why: A gram is a metric unit of mass.
A pound is a customary unit.

vocabulary.definition: A table of equal ratios that shows a pattern.
vocabulary.definitionEs: Una tabla de razones iguales que muestra un patrón.
vocabulary.visual: Cups of juice: 2, 4, 6 | Cups of water: 3, 6, 9
vocabulary.cloze: A table that lists equivalent ratios in rows or columns is a ___.

examples.why: Every column holds the same ratio.
The last column breaks the pattern.

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Bridge Engineering
revealWordProblem.text: The Golden Gate Bridge's two main cables are each about 7,650 feet long. A supply company sells cable-protection wrap in spools measured in yards. How many yards of protective wrap does one full cable need? Show your work using a conversion factor.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: 1 yard = 3 feet, so converting feet to the larger unit (yards) means dividing by the conversion factor: 7,650 ÷ 3 = 2,550 yards. One cable needs 2,550 yards of protective wrap.

questions.stem: How many inches are in 7 feet?
choiceFeedback: There are 12 inches in every foot.
You multiplied by 8 feet. Re-read how many feet the question gives.
hints: The key fact: 1 foot = 12 inches. You have 7 feet and want inches.
Going from a BIGGER unit (feet) to a SMALLER unit (inches) means you multiply.
Set up 7 × 12 — seven groups of 12 inches.
hintsEs: El dato clave: 1 pie = 12 pulgadas. Tienes 7 pies y quieres pulgadas.
Ir de una unidad MAYOR (pies) a una MENOR (pulgadas) significa que multiplicas.
Plantea 7 × 12: siete grupos de 12 pulgadas.

questions.stem: How many feet are in 3 yards?
choiceFeedback: There are 3 feet in every yard.
hints: The key fact: 1 yard = 3 feet. You have 3 yards and want feet.
Big unit (yards) to small unit (feet) means multiply by the conversion factor 3.
Set up 3 × 3 — three yards, each worth 3 feet.
hintsEs: El dato clave: 1 yarda = 3 pies. Tienes 3 yardas y quieres pies.
De unidad grande (yardas) a unidad pequeña (pies) significa multiplicar por el factor de conversión 3.
Plantea 3 × 3: tres yardas, cada una de 3 pies.

questions.stem: How many ounces are in 4 pounds?
choiceFeedback: There are 16 ounces in every pound.
hints: The key fact: 1 pound = 16 ounces. You have 4 pounds and want ounces.
Pounds are bigger than ounces, so converting to ounces means multiplying by 16.
Set up 4 × 16. (Break it up: 4 × 10 = 40 and 4 × 6 = 24, then add.)
hintsEs: El dato clave: 1 libra = 16 onzas. Tienes 4 libras y quieres onzas.
Las libras son mayores que las onzas, así que convertir a onzas significa multiplicar por 16.
Plantea 4 × 16. (Sepáralo: 4 × 10 = 40 y 4 × 6 = 24, y luego suma.)

steps: 1. Write the given measurement as a fraction over 1
2. Multiply by conversion ratios arranged so unwanted units cancel diagonally
3. Multiply numerators, multiply denominators, and simplify the remaining unit
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Convert Measurement Units is applying the conversion factor in the wrong direction — for example, converting 4 feet to inches by dividing (4 ÷ 12 = 0.33 inches) instead of multiplying (4 × 12 = 48 inches), or converting 80 ounces to pounds by multiplying (80 × 16 = 1,280 pounds) instead of dividing (80 ÷ 16 = 5 pounds). Before you answer, ask: am I changing to a SMALLER unit (there will be MORE of them, so multiply) or a BIGGER unit (there will be FEWER of them, so divide)?

level1.stem: There are 3 feet in 1 yard. How many feet are in 7 yards?
level1.stemEs: Hay 3 pies en 1 yarda. ¿Cuántos pies hay en 7 yardas?
hints: The scale factor from 1 yard to 7 yards is 7. Multiply the feet by 7.
hintsEs: El factor de escala de 1 yarda a 7 yardas es 7. Multiplica los pies por 7.
level1.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 yd : 3 ft Find the scale factor: 7 ÷ 1 = 7 Multiply the feet by the same factor: 3 × 7 = 21
level1.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 yd : 3 ft Halla el factor de escala: 7 ÷ 1 = 7 Multiplica los pies por el mismo factor: 3 × 7 = 21

level1.stem: There are 100 centimeters in 1 meter. How many centimeters are in 6 meters?
level1.stemEs: Hay 100 centímetros en 1 metro. ¿Cuántos centímetros hay en 6 metros?
hints: The scale factor from 1 meter to 6 meters is 6. Multiply the centimeters by 6.
hintsEs: El factor de escala de 1 metro a 6 metros es 6. Multiplica los centímetros por 6.
level1.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 m : 100 cm Find the scale factor: 6 ÷ 1 = 6 Multiply the centimeters by the same factor: 100 × 6 = 600
level1.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 m : 100 cm Halla el factor de escala: 6 ÷ 1 = 6 Multiplica los centímetros por el mismo factor: 100 × 6 = 600

level1.stem: There are 16 ounces in 1 pound. How many ounces are in 3 pounds?
level1.stemEs: Hay 16 onzas en 1 libra. ¿Cuántas onzas hay en 3 libras?
hints: The scale factor from 1 pound to 3 pounds is 3. Multiply the ounces by 3.
hintsEs: El factor de escala de 1 libra a 3 libras es 3. Multiplica las onzas por 3.
level1.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 lb : 16 oz Find the scale factor: 3 ÷ 1 = 3 Multiply the ounces by the same factor: 16 × 3 = 48
level1.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 lb : 16 oz Halla el factor de escala: 3 ÷ 1 = 3 Multiplica las onzas por el mismo factor: 16 × 3 = 48

level1.stem: There are 3 feet in 1 yard. How many feet are in 6 yards?
level1.stemEs: Hay 3 pies en 1 yarda. ¿Cuántos pies hay en 6 yardas?
hints: Write 1 yard and 3 feet first. The scale factor from 1 to 6 is 6.
hintsEs: Primero escribe 1 yarda y 3 pies. El factor de escala de 1 a 6 es 6.
level1.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 yd : 3 ft Find the scale factor: 6 ÷ 1 = 6 Multiply the feet by the same factor: 3 × 6 = 18
level1.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 yd : 3 ft Halla el factor de escala: 6 ÷ 1 = 6 Multiplica los pies por el mismo factor: 3 × 6 = 18

level1.stem: There are 16 ounces in 1 pound. How many ounces are in 7 pounds?
level1.stemEs: Hay 16 onzas en 1 libra. ¿Cuántas onzas hay en 7 libras?
hints: Write 1 pound and 16 ounces first. Then scale from 1 pound to 7 pounds.
hintsEs: Primero escribe 1 libra y 16 onzas. Luego escala de 1 libra a 7 libras.
level1.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 lb : 16 oz Find the scale factor: 7 ÷ 1 = 7 Multiply the ounces by the same factor: 16 × 7 = 112
level1.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 lb : 16 oz Halla el factor de escala: 7 ÷ 1 = 7 Multiplica las onzas por el mismo factor: 16 × 7 = 112

level2.stem: Which is longer: 4 yards or 11 feet? Write the longer length in feet.
level2.stemEs: ¿Qué es más largo: 4 yardas u 11 pies? Escribe la longitud más larga en pies.
hints: You cannot compare 4 and 11 yet. Use the table to change 4 yards to feet.
hintsEs: Todavía no puedes comparar 4 y 11. Usa la tabla para cambiar 4 yardas a pies.
level2.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 yd : 3 ft Find the scale factor: 4 ÷ 1 = 4 Multiply the feet by the same factor: 3 × 4 = 12 Compare the two lengths in feet: 12 ft > 11 ft
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 yd : 3 ft Halla el factor de escala: 4 ÷ 1 = 4 Multiplica los pies por el mismo factor: 3 × 4 = 12 Compara las dos longitudes en pies: 12 ft > 11 ft

level2.stem: A fence is 27 feet long. How many yards long is it?
level2.stemEs: Una cerca mide 27 pies de largo. ¿Cuántas yardas mide?
hints: Find the scale factor from 3 feet to 27 feet. Use it on the yards.
hintsEs: Halla el factor de escala de 3 pies a 27 pies. Úsalo con las yardas.
level2.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 yd : 3 ft Find the scale factor: 27 ÷ 3 = 9 Multiply the yards by the same factor: 1 × 9 = 9
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 yd : 3 ft Halla el factor de escala: 27 ÷ 3 = 9 Multiplica las yardas por el mismo factor: 1 × 9 = 9

level2.stem: There are 12 inches in 1 foot. How many inches are in 10 feet?
level2.stemEs: Hay 12 pulgadas en 1 pie. ¿Cuántas pulgadas hay en 10 pies?
hints: Write 1 foot and 12 inches first. Then scale from 1 foot to 10 feet.
hintsEs: Primero escribe 1 pie y 12 pulgadas. Luego escala de 1 pie a 10 pies.
level2.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 ft : 12 in Find the scale factor: 10 ÷ 1 = 10 Multiply the inches by the same factor: 12 × 10 = 120
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 ft : 12 in Halla el factor de escala: 10 ÷ 1 = 10 Multiplica las pulgadas por el mismo factor: 12 × 10 = 120

level2.stem: A board is 90 inches long. How many feet long is it? Write your answer as a decimal.
level2.stemEs: Una tabla mide 90 pulgadas de largo. ¿Cuántos pies mide? Escribe tu respuesta como decimal.
hints: Find the scale factor from 12 inches to 90 inches. It is a decimal.
hintsEs: Halla el factor de escala de 12 pulgadas a 90 pulgadas. Es un decimal.
level2.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 ft : 12 in Find the scale factor: 90 ÷ 12 = 7.5 Multiply the feet by the same factor: 1 × 7.5 = 7.5 Check with the leftover inches: 7 × 12 = 84; 90 − 84 = 6
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 ft : 12 in Halla el factor de escala: 90 ÷ 12 = 7.5 Multiplica los pies por el mismo factor: 1 × 7.5 = 7.5 Comprueba con las pulgadas que sobran: 7 × 12 = 84; 90 − 84 = 6

level2.stem: A jug holds 3 gallons of milk. There are 4 quarts in 1 gallon. How many quarts of milk does the jug hold?
level2.stemEs: Un garrafón contiene 3 galones de leche. Hay 4 cuartos de galón en 1 galón. ¿Cuántos cuartos de galón de leche contiene el garrafón?
hints: Write 1 gallon and 4 quarts first. Then scale from 1 gallon to 3 gallons.
hintsEs: Primero escribe 1 galón y 4 cuartos de galón. Luego escala de 1 galón a 3 galones.
level2.explanation: Write the conversion fact in the table: 1 gal : 4 qt Find the scale factor: 3 ÷ 1 = 3 Multiply the quarts by the same factor: 4 × 3 = 12
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la equivalencia en la tabla: 1 gal : 4 qt Halla el factor de escala: 3 ÷ 1 = 3 Multiplica los cuartos de galón por el mismo factor: 4 × 3 = 12

level3.stem: Convert 3 hours to seconds using 1 hour = 60 minutes and 1 minute = 60 seconds.
choiceFeedback: That multiplies only two of the three numbers. Go hours to minutes to seconds: 3 x 60 x 60.
That is 3 hours converted to MINUTES. Convert once more: 180 minutes x 60 seconds per minute.
That is the number of seconds in ONE hour. Multiply by 3 for three hours.
level3.explanation: 3 hours × 60 minutes per hour = 180 minutes. Then 180 × 60 seconds per minute = 10,800 seconds.

level3.stem: Dee changes 6 yards to inches. She multiplies 6 × 12 and gets 72 inches. What is the correct number of inches?
level3.stemEs: Dee cambia 6 yardas a pulgadas. Multiplica 6 × 12 y obtiene 72 pulgadas. ¿Cuál es el número correcto de pulgadas?
hints: 12 is the number of inches in 1 foot, not in 1 yard. Find the inches in 1 yard first.
hintsEs: 12 es el número de pulgadas en 1 pie, no en 1 yarda. Primero halla las pulgadas en 1 yarda.
level3.explanation: Find the inches in 1 yard: 3 × 12 = 36 Find the scale factor: 6 ÷ 1 = 6 Multiply the feet and inches by 6: 3 × 6 = 18; 36 × 6 = 216
level3.explanationEs: Halla las pulgadas en 1 yarda: 3 × 12 = 36 Halla el factor de escala: 6 ÷ 1 = 6 Multiplica los pies y las pulgadas por 6: 3 × 6 = 18; 36 × 6 = 216

level3.stem: A ribbon is 8 yards long. How many inches long is it? Use 1 yard = 3 feet and 1 foot = 12 inches.
level3.stemEs: Una cinta mide 8 yardas de largo. ¿Cuántas pulgadas mide? Usa 1 yarda = 3 pies y 1 pie = 12 pulgadas.
hints: Find the inches in 1 yard first. Then scale the column by 8.
hintsEs: Primero halla las pulgadas en 1 yarda. Luego escala la columna por 8.
level3.explanation: Find the inches in 1 yard: 3 × 12 = 36 Find the scale factor: 8 ÷ 1 = 8 Multiply the feet and inches by 8: 3 × 8 = 24; 36 × 8 = 288
level3.explanationEs: Halla las pulgadas en 1 yarda: 3 × 12 = 36 Halla el factor de escala: 8 ÷ 1 = 8 Multiplica los pies y las pulgadas por 8: 3 × 8 = 24; 36 × 8 = 288

level3.stem: A soccer game lasts 2 hours. How many seconds is that? Use 1 hour = 60 minutes and 1 minute = 60 seconds.
level3.stemEs: Un partido de fútbol dura 2 horas. ¿Cuántos segundos son? Usa 1 hora = 60 minutos y 1 minuto = 60 segundos.
hints: Find the seconds in 1 hour first. Then scale the column by 2.
hintsEs: Primero halla los segundos en 1 hora. Luego escala la columna por 2.
level3.explanation: Find the seconds in 1 hour: 60 × 60 = 3,600 Find the scale factor: 2 ÷ 1 = 2 Multiply the minutes and seconds by 2: 60 × 2 = 120; 3,600 × 2 = 7,200
level3.explanationEs: Halla los segundos en 1 hora: 60 × 60 = 3,600 Halla el factor de escala: 2 ÷ 1 = 2 Multiplica los minutos y los segundos por 2: 60 × 2 = 120; 3,600 × 2 = 7,200

level3.stem: Each batch of soup needs 3 cups of milk. You have 1 gallon of milk. Use 1 gallon = 4 quarts and 1 quart = 4 cups. How many full batches can you make?
level3.stemEs: Cada tanda de sopa necesita 3 tazas de leche. Tienes 1 galón de leche. Usa 1 galón = 4 cuartos de galón y 1 cuarto = 4 tazas. ¿Cuántas tandas completas puedes hacer?
hints: 1 gallon is 4 quarts. Use the table to find the cups. Then see how many groups of 3 fit.
hintsEs: 1 galón son 4 cuartos de galón. Usa la tabla para hallar las tazas. Luego mira cuántos grupos de 3 caben.
level3.explanation: Change 1 gallon to quarts: 1 × 4 = 4 Multiply the cups by the scale factor 4: 4 × 4 = 16 Find how many groups of 3 fit in 16: 3 × 5 = 15; 16 − 15 = 1 Keep only the full batches: 5 full, 1 cup left
level3.explanationEs: Cambia 1 galón a cuartos de galón: 1 × 4 = 4 Multiplica las tazas por el factor de escala 4: 4 × 4 = 16 Halla cuántos grupos de 3 caben en 16: 3 × 5 = 15; 16 − 15 = 1 Quédate solo con las tandas completas: 5 completas, sobra 1 taza

predict.stem: Before you build the table — 1 foot is 12 inches. How many inches is 7 feet?
predict.explanation: Write 7 feet over 1 and multiply by 12 inches per 1 foot so feet cancel: 7 × 12 = 84 inches.
choiceFeedback: That applies the conversion in the wrong direction, dividing instead of multiplying. Inches are smaller, so there are MORE of them.
That adds 12 to 7 instead of multiplying.
That leaves the number unchanged. Changing the unit changes the number.
